title: Grade 7 leads reading MCA participation at Mahnomen Secondary in 2024-25
text:
Grade 7 leads reading MCA participation at Mahnomen Secondary in 2024-25
L. O. Perez
The seventh grade posted the highest participation in the reading section of the 2024-25 MCA at Mahnomen Secondary School, based on data from the Minnesota Department of Education.
Out of 161 total students who completed the reading portion at Mahnomen Secondary School, 62 were seventh-graders.
According to test standards, 18% of seventh-grade students achieved proficiency in reading.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) serve as Minnesota’s statewide assessments for measuring student progress toward academic standards and fulfilling both federal and state legal requirements. These tests assess math, reading, and science, depending on the student's grade. Most participate in the MCA, while eligible students receiving special education services may take the Alt MCA.
As reported on Minnesota's Report Card, overall proficiency on the state’s MCA exams has decreased compared with pre-pandemic times. Math proficiency declined by over 7% from 2019, and reading proficiency dropped nearly 5%.
| Grade | # of Students Tested | Proficiency in reading |
|---|---|---|
| 7th | 62 | 18% |
| 8th | 53 | 26% |
| 10th | 46 | 33% |
This article is based on information provided by the Minnesota Department of Education. The original data is available here.
